description: Retention/lifecycle daemon from Appendix A. Regenerate attestations approaching expiry. Reads mcp_attestations table for entries where expires_at within 7 days and regenerated_at older than 90 days. Calls attestation_engine logic via write_service to regenerate. Must not DELETE existing attestation rows — archive old ones with regenerated_at timestamp. Write heartbeat to service_health. Use write_service at :8772 for all DB access. Scan interval: daily.
